normalized_claim: Carrier, actions, lens: A carrier is a finite set X of states. normalized_claim: Predictive and observational equivalence: Fix a carrier with declared dynamics and a lens q . Two states (or histories) are observationally equivalent when all admissible current observables agree on them; the induced quotient is the current public quotient Q . They are predictively equivalent when they agree on the full family of admissible future behavior (continuation laws, or distributions over future observable trajectories under all admissible continuations); the induced quotient is the predictive quotient M . Predictive equivalence refines observational equivalence, giving a canonical comparison map pi : M → Q . The gap between them, same Q -class with different M -class, is a factorization defect and is the recurring engine of this paper.

This is a research program specification and an operational toolbox, not a PDE theorem.
